plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% and CRWD to 10% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 25% of the book, favoring income and broad index exposure.
Buy PANW at 5% of the book, adding a top-quality name from the scanner.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2%, reducing leveraged ETF exposure while keeping a small allocation.
Trim SPY to 25% and CRWD to 10% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.
Buy PANW at 5% and AMAT at 5%, adding quality tech names from the scanner.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a diversified approach.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index and quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, bringing each to 6% of the book, leaning into leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to 25% to meet mandate limits and reallocate capital.
Add to CRWD, maintaining its 14% allocation, pressing a strong performer.
Buy PANW at 7% and LAC at 7%, adding high-scoring setups from the scanner.
This plan stretches for growth, using leverage and concentration in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay/rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating all leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30% of the book, rotating into income ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and favor income-generating assets.
Sell CRWD and SMH to zero, cutting high-beta single names.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It rotates heavily into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index, cutting high-beta names. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable income, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
